open_points.subject: add_trial_case / execute_trial_case empty input file lists
open_points.text: A trial case therefore names exactly the contract's input ports, and expected_outputs is either absent or names exactly every output port: a partial expected_outputs, and an empty object, is given and fails presence at its first missing port; only absence means no expected outputs.
open_points.other_text: an input or an expected output of a file list with no files names no StoredValuesRef, so it is read with no call — the input's payload is a FileListPayload with no contents and the expected output's digests are the empty list —, and an expected file list with no files matches an output file list with no files.
open_points.question: Must an empty input file-list port still be named by a StoredValuesRef, or is that port intentionally absent from TrialCase.inputs?

open_points.subject: add_trial_case / execute_trial_case empty expected-output file lists
open_points.text: A trial case therefore names exactly the contract's input ports, and expected_outputs is either absent or names exactly every output port: a partial expected_outputs, and an empty object, is given and fails presence at its first missing port; only absence means no expected outputs.
open_points.other_text: When the case has expected outputs, they MUST be compared per output port of the contract version, never per port the refs happen to name: an output port that no expected StoredValuesRef names is an expected file list with no files.
open_points.question: Must every expected-output port be named in TrialCase.expected_outputs, or does an unnamed output port represent an expected empty file list?
